verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only custom fields on the built-in Person record, which can be used for filtering and sorting, plus a 'relationships' field on people. Nothing documents defining new custom object types with their own fields and relationships. Custom fields on an existing object are an adjacent feature, not custom objects, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
